_doc: MakerBeam: a 10 x 10 mm aluminium beam with a T-slot in each face and a core hole threaded M3 at both ends, for small frames. Dimensions are from MakerBeam B.V.'s technical drawing of the 100 mm beam. Area, second moments and weight are MakerBeam B.V.'s overview of specifications. The drawn outline leaves out the rounds in the slots.
